answer_1.quote: BeSimulator employs a code-driven reasoning mechanism for arithmetic operations... it integrates code generation and code execution via a code interpreter.
answer_1.outputs: Generated code for numerical reasoning and simulation outputs including JSON-formatted state transitions and feasibility analyses

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the simulation performance of BeSimulator, we use the following metrics: • Delivery Rate: This metric assesses whether an LLM-based simulator can successfully deliver a simulation result within finite reflection times of LLMs. • Accuracy: This metric represents the proportion of BTs that are correctly evaluated for the corresponding categories.

answer_3.quote: Best of N with LLM Judge (BoN): According to the CoT method, we sample three candidate answers and then use LLM as a judge to select the best answer based on the correctness of the answers.
methods: Best of N with LLM Judge
